Chapter 729: Chapter 22: Crushing Tier 11 (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 729: Chapter 22: Crushing Tier 11 (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

But he himself had only sustained minor injuries, and he almost lost control of the iron rod ‘strange artifact’ in his hand.

“So be it.”

“First, I’ll kill you.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted towards Pei Shen, and his figure silently disappeared.

“Not good.”

Pei Shen’s heart raced, and before he could react, a figure materialized beside him.

...

“Die.”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and reached out to grab Pei Shen.

“Get away!”

Pei Shen, in a mix of shock and anger, swung his pitch-black iron rod, desperately resisting.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

Lin Yuan forcefully grabbed the iron rod glowing with pitch-black light; it abruptly stopped, then with a gentle tap, the iron rod smashed into Pei Shen’s chest.

“No!”

Pei Shen’s eyes bulged, understanding the might of the pitch-black iron rod all too well. But in the next moment, the rod smashed into his chest.

In a daze,

Pei Shen felt his heart rupture and many other internal organs turned to dust, and even his consciousness quickly began to slip away.

In the Main World, Pei Shen was a powerful Ancient God of Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier, and even with his physical body shattered, he could easily recover. But in the Two-dimensional World, where everything was ordinary, his injuries such as organ dust were fatal, let alone a ruptured heart. He wouldn’t survive long.

The only reason he was not yet dead was because of the strong support of his Spirit Will.

“I possess an attacking ‘strange artifact’…” Pei Shen could not comprehend. The attack of the ‘strange artifact’ was unparalleled, yet each strike with the pitch-black iron rod was effortlessly blocked by Lin Yuan.

What kind of monster was this powerhouse of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses?

Pei Shen could not continue his thoughts as the brilliance in his eyes quickly faded, and he fell to the ground with a thud.

“Strange artifacts are not invincible,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, casually stowing away the pitch-black iron rod.

A hundred years ago, strange artifacts were decisive for the powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes. At that time, ‘Hou Zhu’, who was ranked second among the nine powerhouses, relied on a blood-colored long knife artifact.

But a hundred years later, while ‘Hou Zhu’ still ranked among the nine powerhouses, he had fallen to ninth place.

The stronger the strength, the higher the tier, the weaker the effect of the ‘strange artifacts’ becomes.

Of course, in a battle of the same tier, the one with a ‘strange artifact’ would definitely have a greater advantage.

“You?”

Not far away, Tuoba Ancient God couldn’t help but take a few steps back, looking at Lin Yuan with some trepidation.

Pei Shen’s strength was not inferior to his, and with the pitch-black iron rod, his combat ability was downright terrifying.

But in the hands of Lin Yuan, he couldn’t even last two breaths.

This scene made the originally planning to rescue Tuoba Ancient God tremble inside.

He hadn’t even made his move, and Pei Shen was already dead?

“Run.”

Tuoba Ancient God did not hesitate to turn around and run.

The remaining three special beings also reacted.

But they were quickly killed by Lin Yuan with a slap.

“You can’t escape,” Lin Yuan said as he chased after Tuoba Ancient God.

In terms of sensory coverage, he was twice as large as Tuoba Ancient God, and in terms of full-burst speed, he far exceeded Tuoba Ancient God.

Soon.

Lin Yuan approached Tuoba Ancient God from behind and slapped him directly.

This slap, if placed on Pei Shen earlier, would have left him either dead or incapacitated.

But it landed on Tuoba Ancient God’s back, causing the latter’s figure to tremble and then, using the force of the slap, he escaped even faster into the distance.

“That defensive artifact?”

Lin Yuan was not surprised, having first dealt with those four special beings and Pei Shen.

Putting Tuoba Ancient God last,

was because of the defensive artifact that Tuoba Ancient God possessed.

Tuoba Ancient God, with his defensive artifact, was definitely the hardest to kill out of the six special beings.

“My lord, there is no deep hatred between us; as long as you let me go, I am willing to pay any price,” Tuoba Ancient God pleaded while continuing his frantic flight.

The ‘any price’ here referred to what the true body of Tuoba Ancient God in the Main Universe was willing to pay.

“Any price?” Lin Yuan was unmoved; could any price be comparable to the defensive artifact on Tuoba Ancient God?

Once this defensive artifact returned to the Main Universe, even Supreme Beings would envy it.

“If Your Honor is not satisfied, the terms are negotiable,” Tuoba Ancient God said, anxiety filling his heart.

In his eyes, Lin Yuan, bursting forth with such strength, was definitely a powerhouse on the level of ‘Mother of the Tree Realm’ or the ‘Four Divine Kings’ in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

…

Tuoba Ancient God frantically fled, occasionally taking a hit from Lin Yuan, flying away like a rubber ball.

The chase between the two quickly drew the attention of other powerhouses from Myriad Clans, as Tuoba Ancient God and the other special beings searched the Xueyu Ancient Country.

Powerhouses from Myriad Clans within the Ancient Country, having received the news, naturally steered clear well in advance, but the commotion from the chase was too great, the aura, far surpassing that of Witch Ancestor, rippled out in all directions.

Moreover, with the death of the four special beings and Pei Shen, when their true bodies in the Main Universe went public with this incident, it sparked extensive discussions among many powerhouses of the Myriad Clans.

“Tuoba Ancient God, that’s an Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier special being. Pei Shen is also of the same level, and the two together, along with four other Eleventh Rank beings, were chased by an unseen powerhouse from Myriad Clans?”

“Not chased, out of the six special beings, Pei Shen and the other four are already dead, only Tuoba Ancient God remains…”

“Right, Tuoba Ancient God’s survival till now is probably due to that defensive artifact, otherwise, he would have probably died just like Pei Shen at the hands of that mysterious powerhouse.”

Many powerhouses of Myriad Clans exchanged words and couldn’t help feeling schadenfreude,

The vast majority of powerhouses from Myriad Clans were Eighth, Ninth, or Tenth Rank, and they were extremely afraid of being hunted by special beings like Tuoba Ancient God.

But now, Tuoba Ancient God and his peers were being overwhelmingly chased by that mysterious powerhouse from Myriad Clans.

These slightly weaker powerhouses from Myriad Clans felt a sense of relief.
